```
/**
 * ContextUsageTracker — KSA-249
 * Tracks token consumption per category per tab.
 * Categories: conversation, mcpTools, steering.
 * Provides payload for webview context usage panel.
 */

import { ContextThreshold } from "./conversation-types";

export interface ContextUsagePayload {
  tabId: string;
  conversation: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  mcpTools: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  steering: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  total: { tokens: number; percentage: number; threshold: ContextThreshold };
  maxTokens: number;
}

interface TabContextUsage {
  conversation: number;
  mcpTools: number;
  steering: number;
}

/** Thresholds for context usage state */
const THRESHOLDS = {
  safe: 0.6,
  warning: 0.8,
  critical: 0.95,
};

export class ContextUsageTracker {
  private tabUsage: Map<string, TabContextUsage> = new Map();
  private maxTokens: number;

  constructor(maxTokens = 128000) {
    this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
  }

  /**
   * Update conversation token count from messages.
   */
  updateFromMessages(tabId: string, messages: Array<{ content: string }>): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    let total = 0;
    for (const msg of messages) {
      total += this.estimateTokens(msg.content);
    }
    usage.conversation = total;
  }

  /**
   * Add tokens from tool results.
   */
  addToolTokens(tabId: string, toolResult: string): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    usage.mcpTools += this.estimateTokens(toolResult);
  }

  /**
   * Update steering token count from loaded steering content.
   */
  updateSteeringTokens(tabId: string, steeringContent: string[]): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    let total = 0;
    for (const content of steeringContent) {
      total += this.estimateTokens(content);
    }
    usage.steering = total;
  }

  /**
   * Set max tokens (e.g., when model changes).
   */
  setMaxTokens(maxTokens: number): void {
    this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
  }

  /**
   * Get the current usage payload for a tab.
   */
  getUsagePayload(tabId: string): ContextUsagePayload {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    const total = usage.conversation + usage.mcpTools + usage.steering;
    const percentage = this.maxTokens > 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round((total / this.maxTokens) * 100))
      : 0;

    return {
      tabId,
      conversation: {
        tokens: usage.conversation,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.conversation),
      },
      mcpTools: {
        tokens: usage.mcpTools,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.mcpTools),
      },
      steering: {
        tokens: usage.steering,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.steering),
      },
      total: {
        tokens: total,
        percentage,
        threshold: this.getThreshold(percentage),
      },
      maxTokens: this.maxTokens,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clear usage data for a tab.
   */
  clearTab(tabId: string): void {
    this.tabUsage.delete(tabId);
  }

  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {
    if (!text) return 0;
    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
  }

  private pct(tokens: number): number {
    return this.maxTokens > 0 ? Math.round((tokens / this.maxTokens) * 100) : 0;
  }

  private getThreshold(percentage: number): ContextThreshold {
    const ratio = percentage / 100;
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.critical) return "full";
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.warning) return "critical";
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.safe) return "warning";
    return "safe";
  }

  private getOrCreateUsage(tabId: string): TabContextUsage {
    let usage = this.tabUsage.get(tabId);
    if (!usage) {
      usage = { conversation: 0, mcpTools: 0, steering: 0 };
      this.tabUsage.set(tabId, usage);
    }
    return usage;
  }
}
```

```
/**
 * SA4E-85 — Context Store.
 * Tracks token usage, context window files, and prune suggestions.
 * Derives usage percentage for UI progress indicators.
 */

import { writable, derived } from 'svelte/store';
import type { ContextFile } from '../../chat/types';

/** Suggestion to prune a file from context to free tokens */
export interface PruneSuggestion {
  filePath: string;
  tokensSaved: number;
  reason: string;
}

/** Internal state for context window tracking */
interface ContextState {
  tokenCount: number;
  maxTokens: number;
  files: ContextFile[];
  pruneSuggestions: PruneSuggestion[];
}

const initialState: ContextState = {
  tokenCount: 0,
  maxTokens: 128000,
  files: [],
  pruneSuggestions: [],
};

/** Core writable store for context state */
export const contextState = writable<ContextState>(initialState);

/** Derived: usage percentage (0-100) */
export const usagePercent = derived(contextState, ($s) =>
  $s.maxTokens > 0 ? Math.round(($s.tokenCount / $s.maxTokens) * 100) : 0
);

/** Derived: context files list */
export const contextFiles = derived(contextState, ($s) => $s.files);

/** Derived: token count */
export const tokenCount = derived(contextState, ($s) => $s.tokenCount);

/** Derived: prune suggestions */
export const pruneSuggestions = derived(contextState, ($s) => $s.pruneSuggestions);

/** Update context from Extension Host CONTEXT_UPDATE message */
export function updateContext(
  tokenCount: number,
  maxTokens: number,
  files: ContextFile[]
): void {
  contextState.update((s) => ({
    ...s,
    tokenCount,
    maxTokens,
    files,
  }));
}

/** Set prune suggestions (computed by Extension Host) */
export function setPruneSuggestions(suggestions: PruneSuggestion[]): void {
  contextState.update((s) => ({ ...s, pruneSuggestions: suggestions }));
}

/** Reset context state */
export function resetContext(): void {
  contextState.set(initialState);
}
```

```
    this.reindexSubscriber?.stop();
    this.reindexSubscriber = undefined;
    this.clientManager.stopHealthMonitor();
    await this.clientManager.shutdownAll();

  getToolHandlers(): Map<string, ToolHandler> {
    const handlers = new Map<string, ToolHandler>();

    handlers.set('orchestration_status', async () => {
      const servers = this.clientManager.getServersStatus();
      const totalProxiedTools = servers.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.toolCount, 0);
      return {
        content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ servers, serverCount: servers.length, totalProxiedTools, status: 'ready' }) }],
        isError: false,
      };
    });

      const query = args.query as string;
      const limit = (args.top_k as number) || 5;

      if (!this.toolSearchService) {
        this.logger.warn('find_tools called but ToolSearchService not yet injected');
        return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ tools: [], query }) }], isError: false };
      }

      const tools = await this.toolSearchService.search(query, limit);
      return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ tools, query }) }], isError: false };
    });

      // Child servers are separate processes with their own schemas — forward ONLY
      // the caller's declared arguments, never our internal scope keys (avoid leaking
      // __projectId/_projectContext to third-party servers and tripping strict schemas).
      if (this.clientManager.ownsTool(toolName)) {
        try {

          if (this.registry && !result.isError) {

        } catch (err: any) {
          return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Error proxying tool ${toolName}: ${err.message || err}` }], isError: true };

      if (!this.registry) {
        return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Registry not available' }], isError: true };
      }

      const handler = this.registry.getToolHandlers().get(toolName);
      if (!handler) {

      const toolArgs = propagateScope(args, innerArgs);
```

```
/**
 * ChatStatusManager — handles combined MCP + LLM status checking
 * and notifies the webview of connection state changes.
 */

import * as vscode from "vscode";
import { createLlmProvider } from "../mcp/providers";
import { IServerManager } from "../types/server-types";
import { mapServerStatusToWebview } from "../types";
import { ChatExtToWebviewMessage } from "./message-protocol";

export class ChatStatusManager {
  constructor(
    private readonly mcpManager: IServerManager,
    private readonly secrets?: vscode.SecretStorage,
    private readonly sendToWebview?: (msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void
  ) {}

  /**
   * Called by Settings panel when LLM test succeeds/fails.
   */
  notifyLlmStatusChanged(status: "connected" | "disconnected"): void {
    this.sendToWebview?.({ type: "serverStatus", status });
  }

  /**
   * Check both MCP server AND LLM provider availability.
   * Status = "connected" only when BOTH are working.
   */
  async sendCombinedStatus(): Promise<void> {
    const mcpStatus = this.mcpManager.status;
    const webviewStatus = mapServerStatusToWebview(mcpStatus);

    // SA4E-391: feed the sidebar MCP list (currently the single code-intel server).
    this.sendToWebview?.({
      type: "chat:mcpServers",
      servers: [{ name: "code-intel", status: webviewStatus }],
    });

    if (webviewStatus !== "connected") {
      this.sendToWebview?.({ type: "serverStatus", status: webviewStatus });
      return;
    }

    try {
      const provider = createLlmProvider(this.secrets);
      const llmAvailable = await provider.isAvailable();
      provider.dispose();
      const status = llmAvailable ? "connected" : "disconnected";
      this.sendToWebview?.({ type: "serverStatus", status });
    } catch (err) {
      console.debug(`[ChatStatusManager] LLM availability check failed (non-fatal): ${(err as Error).message}`);
      this.sendToWebview?.({ type: "serverStatus", status: "disconnected" });
    }
  }
}
```

```
  initialDelay: number;

  maxRetries: number;

}

export interface ServerConnectionState {

}

export const DEFAULT_HEALTH_CONFIG: HealthCheckConfig = {

};

/** Production-tuned config: longer timeouts for stdio servers, less aggressive failure detection */

};

/** Valid state transitions map */

  connected: ['unhealthy', 'disconnected'],
  unhealthy: ['reconnecting'],
  reconnecting: ['connected', 'reconnecting', 'failed', 'disconnected'],

};
```

I've traced how the context count is computed and how the MCP list is wired. Here's my analysis and the design for the two clickable panels you want.

## 1. How the context count is computed today

Two layers, both dividing by the model's **maxTokens** (context window size):

**Estimator** — `ContextUsageTracker.estimateTokens()` in `chat-panel/context-usage-tracker.ts`:
```ts
estimateTokens(text) => Math.ceil(text.length / 4)   // 4 chars ≈ 1 token
```
Tokens are summed across three buckets:
- `conversation` — every chat message body
- `mcpTools` — every MCP tool-result string
- `steering` — every loaded steering skill

**Percentage** — `contextStore.usagePercent`:
```ts
usagePercent = tokenCount / maxTokens * 100
```
`maxTokens` default = **128,000** (GPT-4-class context window).

## 2. What "4% on LLM context length" means in tokens

```
4% × 128,000 = 0.04 × 128,000 = 5,120 tokens
```

So a badge reading `4%` (e.g. `5,120 / 128,000`) means the whole context — conversation + MCP tool results + steering — occupies about **5.1 k tokens**, roughly the size of a short skill doc. That's a *very* lean context; a full SA4E run is ~500–700 k tokens (≈3.9–5.5%).

## 3. Design: two expandable panels

### A. Context Badge → "Context Detail" panel (your `context-optimization` skill)

Currently clicking only expands a flat **file list**. You want it to render the *context-optimization* knowledge (per-phase breakdown, model tiering, token estimates, compaction guidance).

**Data model** (`ContextDetailPayload`):
```ts
{
  usage: { used, max, percent, threshold: 'safe'|'warning'|'critical'|'full' },
  buckets: { conversation: {used, pct, lines}, mcpTools: {...}, steering: {...} },
  phases: [ { name: 'BRD', tier: 'Tier 1 (full)', tokens: 40000, range: 'TDD §3' } ]  // from skill table
  tiering: [ { task, complexity, tier, rationale } ]  // the Model Tiering Table
  budgets: { fullRun: '500k–700k', withRetries: '700k–1M' }  // token estimation
  guidance: [ 'When to Compact', 'How to Compact', 'Anti-Patterns' ]  // summarized
}
```

**UI:** badge shows `5,120 / 128,000 · 4% · 🟢` → click expands a tabbed panel:
- **Usage** tab: the three buckets as bars + threshold badge
- **Phases** tab: per-document token table (BRD/FSD/TA/TDD/…) with line refs
- **Tiering** tab: model-tier table (who does what at Tier 1/2/3)
- **Guidance** tab: when-to-compact triggers + anti-patterns

The payload is generated from the skill (`context-optimization/SKILL.md`) at ingest time and written to the context store, so the panel is self-describing.

### B. MCP List → "MCP Status" panel

Currently the sidebar shows a single static `code-intel` entry (`ChatStatusManager.sendCombinedStatus`). You want clicking the list to expand a live **per-server status** panel.

**Source:** `OrchestrationModule.orchestration_status` → `clientManager.getServersStatus()`, shape `ServerStatusEntry`:
```ts
{ name, state: 'connected'|'unhealthy'|'reconnecting'|'failed'|'disconnected',
  toolCount, lastHealthCheck, consecutiveFailures, lastError, nextRetryAt }
```

**UI:** click the MCP list → panel renders one row per server with a colored dot (green/yellow/red), tool count, last health check time, and error text if failed. Totals row: `online / total`, `Σ tools`.

```
/**
 * TokenCounter — KSA-240
 * Calculates token usage for conversations.
 * Uses character-based estimation (4 chars ~ 1 token) as default.
 * Can be upgraded to use tiktoken for exact counts.
 */

import { TabMessage, ContextThreshold } from "./conversation-types";

export interface TokenCounterConfig {
  warningThreshold: number;  // default 0.6 (60%)
  criticalThreshold: number; // default 0.8 (80%)
  fullThreshold: number;     // default 0.95 (95%)
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: TokenCounterConfig = {
  warningThreshold: 0.6,
  criticalThreshold: 0.8,
  fullThreshold: 0.95,
};

export class TokenCounter {
  private config: TokenCounterConfig;

  constructor(config: Partial<TokenCounterConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
  }

  /**
   * Estimate token count for a single message.
   * Uses ~4 characters per token heuristic.
   * Override with tiktoken integration for production accuracy.
   */
  countMessageTokens(content: string): number {
    if (!content) return 0;
    // ~4 chars per token is a reasonable English estimate
    // Add overhead for message formatting (role, separators)
    return Math.ceil(content.length / 4) + 4;
  }

  /**
   * Calculate total token count for all messages in a conversation.
   */
  countConversationTokens(messages: TabMessage[]): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (const msg of messages) {
      total += msg.tokenCount || this.countMessageTokens(msg.content);
    }
    // Add base overhead (system prompt, formatting)
    total += 100;
    return total;
  }

  /**
   * Get usage percentage (0-100).
   */
  getUsagePercentage(tokenCount: number, maxTokens: number): number {
    if (maxTokens <= 0) return 0;
    return Math.min(100, Math.round((tokenCount / maxTokens) * 100));
  }

  /**
   * Determine the threshold state based on usage percentage.
   */
  getThresholdState(percentage: number): ContextThreshold {
    const ratio = percentage / 100;
    if (ratio >= this.config.fullThreshold) return "full";
    if (ratio >= this.config.criticalThreshold) return "critical";
    if (ratio >= this.config.warningThreshold) return "warning";
    return "safe";
  }

  /**
   * Get max tokens for a given model.
   * Returns reasonable defaults based on known model context windows.
   */
  getMaxTokensForModel(model: string): number {
    const modelLimits: Record<string, number> = {
      "claude-sonnet-4-20250514": 200000,
      "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": 200000,
      "claude-3-haiku-20240307": 200000,
      "claude-3-opus-20240229": 200000,
      "gpt-4o": 128000,
      "gpt-4o-mini": 128000,
      "gpt-4-turbo": 128000,
      "deepseek-chat": 64000,
      "deepseek-coder": 64000,
      "qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct": 8192,
      "qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct": 32768,
      "qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct": 32768,
      "qwen2.5-7b-instruct": 8192,
      "qwen2.5-14b-instruct": 32768,
      "qwen2.5-72b-instruct": 131072,
      "llama3.1-8b": 8192,
      "llama3.1-70b": 128000,
      "mistral-7b": 8192,
      "codestral": 32768,
    };

    // Check exact match first
    if (modelLimits[model]) return modelLimits[model];

    // Check prefix match
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(modelLimits)) {
      if (model.startsWith(key.split("-").slice(0, 2).join("-"))) {
        return value;
      }
    }

    // Default fallback
    return 128000;
  }
}
```

```
async function detectInitialContextWindow(deps: ContextUsageDeps): Promise<void> {
  const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const detectedWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  if (detectedWindow && detectedWindow > 0) {
    deps.getTracker().setMaxTokens(detectedWindow);

  if (!deps.getFlags().steeringCounted) {
    // injectSteering caps at 4000 chars of steering content + system prompt base (~3500 chars)
    const SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE_CHARS = 3500;
    const MAX_STEERING_CHARS = 4000; // mirrors steering-loader.ts injectSteering budget
    const steeringChars = SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE_CHARS + MAX_STEERING_CHARS;
    deps.getTracker().updateSteeringTokens(tabId, ["x".repeat(steeringChars)]);
    deps.getFlags().steeringCounted = true;
  }
}
```

```
import * as vscode from "vscode";

import { applyCodeToEditor, insertCodeToEditor, pickAttachmentFiles, pickChatContext } from "./chat-panel-provider/code-actions";
import { setLlmModelConfig } from "./chat-panel-provider/model-config";

export class ChatPanelProvider implements vscode.WebviewViewProvider, vscode.Disposable {
  public static readonly viewType = "sdlcChatPanel";

  private view: vscode.WebviewView | undefined;
  private engine: PiWorkflowAdapter | null = null;
  private messageHandler: MessageHandler | null = null;
  private messageBuffer: ChatExtToWebviewMessage[] = [];
  private contextUsageTracker: ContextUsageTracker = new ContextUsageTracker();
  private sessionCompactor: SessionCompactor = new SessionCompactor();
  private readonly countedFlags = new CountedFlags();
  private readonly contextUsageDeps: ContextUsageDeps;
  private disposables: vscode.Disposable[] = [];

  private readonly statusManager: ChatStatusManager;
  private readonly modelManager: ChatModelManager;
  private readonly stateManager: ChatStateManager;
  private readonly engineListeners = new Set<(msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void>();
  /** SA4E-391 Bug 1: track the producing tab per streamId / per tool-call id

  constructor(
    private readonly extensionUri: vscode.Uri,
    private readonly mcpManager: IServerManager,
    private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    private readonly secrets?: vscode.SecretStorage,
    private readonly workspaceState?: vscode.Memento,
    private readonly extensionContext?: vscode.ExtensionContext
  ) {
    this.extensionContext = extensionContext;
    this.stateManager = new ChatStateManager(workspaceRoot, workspaceState, this.extensionContext, (msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg), () => this.getEngine());
    this.statusManager = new ChatStatusManager(mcpManager, secrets, (msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg));
    this.modelManager = new ChatModelManager((msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg));
    this.contextUsageDeps = {
      getOrCreateEngine: () => this.getEngine(),
      peekEngine: () => this.engine,
      getTabId: () => this.getEngine().getActiveTabId(),
      getTracker: () => this.contextUsageTracker,
      getFlags: () => this.countedFlags,
      getCompactor: () => this.sessionCompactor,
      sendToWebview: (msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg),
    };
    this.disposables.push(this.stateManager);
  }

  /** SA4E-183: Set the DiffTracker for file change tracking. */
  setDiffTracker(tracker: import('../chat/diff/IDiffTracker').IDiffTracker): void {
    this.diffTracker = tracker;
  }

  resolveWebviewView(webviewView: vscode.WebviewView, _context: vscode.WebviewViewResolveContext, _token: vscode.CancellationToken): void {
    this.view = webviewView;
    webviewView.webview.options = { enableScripts: true, localResourceRoots: [vscode.Uri.joinPath(this.extensionUri, "webview-assets"), vscode.Uri.joinPath(this.extensionUri, "out")] };
    webviewView.webview.html = this.getHtml(webviewView.webview);
    webviewView.webview.onDidReceiveMessage((msg: ChatWebviewToExtMessage) => this.routeMessage(msg), undefined, this.disposables);
    webviewView.onDidDispose(() => { this.view = undefined; });
    webviewView.onDidChangeVisibility(() => this.flushBuffer(webviewView));
    this.mcpManager.onStatusChange(() => { void this.statusManager.sendCombinedStatus(); }, undefined, this.disposables);
    this.disposables.push(vscode.workspace.onDidChangeConfiguration((e) => this.onConfigChange(e)));
  }

  notifyLlmStatusChanged(status: "connected" | "disconnected"): void {
    console.log(`[ChatPanel] notifyLlmStatusChanged: ${status}, view=${!!this.view}`);
    this.statusManager.notifyLlmStatusChanged(status);
  }

  /** Get the id of the currently active tab for this provider view. */

    return "default";

  /** Subscribe to every engine message (sidebar stays the default sink). */
  onEngineMessage(listener: (msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void): vscode.Disposable {
    this.engineListeners.add(listener);
    return { dispose: () => { this.engineListeners.delete(listener); } };
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.engine?.dispose();
    this.disposables.forEach(d => d.dispose());

  private routeMessage(msg: ChatWebviewToExtMessage): void {
    // SA4E-381 Issue 1 / SA4E-391 Issue 2: capture the REAL active tab id when a
    // user message starts a new turn — all subsequent stream/tool events in that
    // turn carry originTabId so the receiving tab attributes them correctly.
    // The webview stamps its activeTabId (a UUID) on the user message; a missing
    // tabId means a legacy/single-tab client, so fall back to undefined (the
    // webview then treats events as belonging to the viewed tab).
    if (msg.type === "chat:userMessage") {
      this.turnTabId = msg.tabId;

    if (handleBuiltinChatMessage(msg, {
      saveChatState: (payload) => {

        // SA4E-369 round-6b: the REAL hot path — the webview's full tab list
        // (id + name) arrives with every save. The provider's saveChatState

        syncPeerTabNames(payload.tabs as ReadonlyArray<{ id?: unknown; name?: unknown }>, this.workspaceRoot);

    })) { return; }

      void this.modelManager.sendModels();
      this.stateManager.restoreChatState();
      this.stateManager.sendSteeringInfo();
      this.stateManager.sendAgentsInfo();
      this.stateManager.sendSkillsInfo();
      void runInitialContextUsage(this.contextUsageDeps);
    }
    this.handleMessage(msg);
  }

  private onConfigChange(e: vscode.ConfigurationChangeEvent): void {
    applyChatConfigChange(e, {
      peekEngine: () => this.engine,
      getSecrets: () => this.secrets,
      sendModels: () => this.modelManager.sendModels(),
      sendCombinedStatus: () => this.statusManager.sendCombinedStatus(),

  }

  private flushBuffer(webviewView: vscode.WebviewView): void {
    if (webviewView.visible && this.messageBuffer.length > 0) {
      for (const msg of this.messageBuffer) {
        webviewView.webview.postMessage(msg);
      }
      this.messageBuffer = [];
    }
  }

  private sendToWebview(msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage): void {
    // SA4E-381 Issue 1: stamp originTabId on peer-capable protocol messages
    // so the receiving tab can attribute messages to the correct source tab.
    const protocolTypes = [
      "chat:streamChunk",
      "chat:streamComplete",
      "chat:toolCall",
      "chat:toolCallUpdate",
      "chat:toolApprovalPending",
      "chat:error"

    // SA4E-391 Bug 1 (cross-tab thinking leak): the ADAPTER stamps originTabId
    // at the source of every turn event (StreamHandler for stream events,
    // postToolLiveEvent for live tool events, the error emitters), pinned to the
    // tab that PRODUCED the turn. That stamp is authoritative — NEVER overwrite
    // it.
    //
    // The fallbacks below only serve LEGACY event paths that reach the host
    // without an origin. They are keyed by the event's OWN identity (streamId
    // for stream events, tool-call id for tool events) so a late event can
    // never be re-stamped with a DIFFERENT turn's tab — the bug that made one
    // tab's thinking block appear in another tab.
    if (protocolTypes.includes(msg.type)) {

        originTabId?: string; streamId?: string; id?: string; toolCall?: { id?: string };
      };
      const streamId = typedMsg.streamId;
      const toolId = typedMsg.toolCall?.id ?? (msg.type === "chat:toolCallUpdate" ? typedMsg.id : undefined);
      if (!typedMsg.originTabId) {
        typedMsg.originTabId = this.resolveFallbackOrigin(streamId, toolId);
        msg = typedMsg as unknown as ChatExtToWebviewMessage;
      }
      // Remember the resolved origin under the event's own identity so the
      // matching follow-up event (toolCallUpdate) resolves to the SAME tab.
      if (streamId && typedMsg.originTabId) this.streamTurnTabId.set(streamId, typedMsg.originTabId);
      if (toolId && typedMsg.originTabId && msg.type === "chat:toolCall") {
        this.toolCallTabId.set(toolId, typedMsg.originTabId);
      }
      // Clean up the per-stream / per-tool maps once the event settles.
      if (msg.type === "chat:streamComplete" && streamId) this.streamTurnTabId.delete(streamId);
      if (msg.type === "chat:toolCallUpdate" && toolId) this.toolCallTabId.delete(toolId);
    }
    if (this.view) {
      this.view.webview.postMessage(msg);
      if ((msg as any).type === "serverStatus") {
        console.log(`[ChatPanel] postMessage serverStatus: ${(msg as any).status}`);
      }
    } else {
      this.messageBuffer.push(msg);
      if (this.messageBuffer.length > 200) { this.messageBuffer.shift(); }

   * global "last submitting tab" hint, so a late event stays with its turn.
   */
  private resolveFallbackOrigin(streamId?: string, toolId?: string): string | undefined {
    const streamTabId = streamId ? this.streamTurnTabId.get(streamId) : undefined;
    if (streamTabId) return streamTabId;
    const toolTabId = toolId ? this.toolCallTabId.get(toolId) : undefined;
    if (toolTabId) return toolTabId;
    return this.turnTabId;
  }

  private getEngine(): PiWorkflowAdapter {
    if (!this.engine) {
      this.engine = createChatEngine(this.mcpManager, this.workspaceRoot, this.secrets, (msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg), this.engineListeners);
    }
    return this.engine;
  }

  private getMessageHandler(): MessageHandler {
    if (!this.messageHandler) {
      this.messageHandler = new MessageHandler(() => this.getEngine(), (msg) => this.sendToWebview(msg), this.workspaceRoot, (ct) => pickChatContext(this.workspaceRoot, (m) => this.sendToWebview(m), ct), () => pickAttachmentFiles((m) => this.sendToWebview(m)), (code, filePath) => applyCodeToEditor(code, filePath), (code) => insertCodeToEditor(code), (model) => setLlmModelConfig(model), () => this.updateContextUsageAfterTurn(), () => this.stateManager.broadcastInitialState());
    }
    return this.messageHandler;
  }

  private async handleMessage(msg: ChatWebviewToExtMessage): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.getMessageHandler().handle(msg);
    } catch (error) {
      this.sendToWebview({
        type: "chat:error", code: "HANDLER_ERROR",
        message: (error as Error).message, retryable: true,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * SA4E-182: Update context token usage after each LLM turn (see context-compaction.ts).
   */
  private updateContextUsageAfterTurn(): void {
    runContextUsageAfterTurn(this.contextUsageDeps);
  }

  private getHtml(webview: vscode.Webview): string {
    const { ChatHtmlBuilder } = require("./ChatHtmlBuilder");
    return ChatHtmlBuilder.build(webview, this.extensionUri);
  }
}
```

```
/**
 * ChatModelManager — handles model list fetching and sending to webview.
 */

import { getStaticModels, getDefaultModel, fetchGatewayModels } from "./chat-models";
import { ChatExtToWebviewMessage } from "./message-protocol";
import { readProviderTurnConfig } from "../pi-workflow/pi-provider-config-bridge.js";

export class ChatModelManager {
  constructor(
    private readonly sendToWebview: (msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void
  ) {}

  /**
   * Build and send the provider-aware model list to the webview.
   * For gateway providers, attempts /v1/models first, falling back to static catalog.
   * SA4E-369 UAT fix: provider/baseUrl/model read via the SHARED config helper
   * (dot keys + legacy flat-key fallback) — plain config.get('llm.provider')
   * returned the manifest default for users still holding the flat keys
   * (llmProvider=lmstudio), so the webview showed the wrong model list.
   */
  async sendModels(): Promise<void> {
    const { providerId: provider, baseUrl, configuredModelId: llmModel } = readProviderTurnConfig();

    let models = getStaticModels(provider);

    const isLocalGatewayBaseUrl = baseUrl !== undefined && baseUrl.includes("127.0.0.1");
    if (isLocalGatewayBaseUrl || provider === "lmstudio") {
      // Gateway provider (or any provider pointed at a local gateway):
      // the real /v1/models list wins over the static catalog.
      const gatewayBaseUrl = baseUrl
        ?? (provider === "lmstudio" ? "http://localhost:1234/v1" : undefined);
      if (gatewayBaseUrl) {
        const gatewayModels = await fetchGatewayModels(gatewayBaseUrl);
        if (gatewayModels && gatewayModels.length > 0) {
          models = gatewayModels;
        }
      }
    }

    // SA4E-391: "auto" is offered ONLY when the LLM server actually advertises
    // an "auto" model in /v1/models. We never fabricate "auto" ourselves — a
    // server that doesn't route "auto" would otherwise leave the user picking a
    // phantom model whose concrete resolution they can't see or control.
    const serverHasAuto = models.some((m) => m.id.toLowerCase() === "auto");

    let selected = llmModel;
    if (selected && selected.toLowerCase() === "auto" && !serverHasAuto) {
      // A stale "auto" from a previous session but the server no longer offers
      // it → fall back to the first real model so the tab runs a known model.
      selected = models.length > 0 ? models[0].id : getDefaultModel(provider);
    } else if (selected && !models.some((m) => m.id === selected)) {
      models = [...models, { id: selected, name: selected }];
    } else if (!selected) {
      selected = models.length > 0 ? models[0].id : getDefaultModel(provider);
    }

    this.sendToWebview({
      type: "chat:models",
      provider,
      models,
      selected,
      supportsAuto: serverHasAuto,
    });
  }
}
```

```
/**
 * ChatPanelProvider — reaction to configuration changes (LLM provider/model,
 * provider base URLs). Extracted from ChatPanelProvider.onConfigChange;
 * behavior is preserved exactly. SA4E-370: listens on new dotted keys only.
 * Legacy flat keys are handled by one-time migration at activation.
 */

import * as vscode from "vscode";
import type { PiWorkflowAdapter } from "../../pi-workflow";
import { createLlmProvider } from "../../mcp/providers";

/** Collaborators the config-change reaction needs from ChatPanelProvider. */
export interface ChatConfigDeps {
  peekEngine: () => PiWorkflowAdapter | null;
  getSecrets: () => vscode.SecretStorage | undefined;
  sendModels: () => unknown;
  sendCombinedStatus: () => unknown;
}

export function applyChatConfigChange(e: vscode.ConfigurationChangeEvent, deps: ChatConfigDeps): void {
  const providerChanged =
    e.affectsConfiguration("sdlcAgents.llm.provider");
  const modelChanged =
    e.affectsConfiguration("sdlcAgents.llm.model");
  if (providerChanged || modelChanged) {
    const engine = deps.peekEngine();
    const secrets = deps.getSecrets();
    if (engine && secrets) { engine.setLlmProvider(createLlmProvider(secrets)); }
    void deps.sendModels();
    void deps.sendCombinedStatus();
  }
  const baseUrlChanged = [
    "llm.anthropic.baseUrl",
    "llm.openai.baseUrl",
    "llm.ollama.baseUrl",
  ].some(n =>
    e.affectsConfiguration(`sdlcAgents.${n}`));
  if (baseUrlChanged) {
    void deps.sendCombinedStatus();
  }
}
```

```
   * (probe meta.n_ctx → runtime registry → default). Gateway-registered models
   * carry the real context_length / meta.n_ctx parsed at registration.
   */
  getModelContextWindow(): number | undefined {
    if (!this.models || !this.providerId || !this.modelId) return undefined;
    try {
      const model = this.models.getModel(this.providerId, this.modelId) as { contextWindow?: number } | undefined;
      const w = model?.contextWindow;
      return typeof w === 'number' && Number.isFinite(w) && w > 0 ? Math.floor(w) : undefined;

   * PI-MODEL-FALLBACK: set the ordered list of model ids to try (in order) when a
   * run fails with a transient/gateway error. Only ids that exist in the registry
   * for `providerId` are kept; unknown ids are dropped (they'd just error again).
   * @param providerId provider whose registry validates the ids
   * @param modelIds ordered candidate model ids (first = primary, rest = fallbacks)
   */
  setFallbackModels(providerId: string, modelIds: string[]): void {
    if (!this.models) { this.fallbackModelIds = []; return; }
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const valid: string[] = [];
    for (const id of modelIds) {
      const trimmed = id?.trim();
      if (!trimmed || seen.has(trimmed)) continue;
      seen.add(trimmed);
      if (this.models.getModel(providerId, trimmed)) { valid.push(trimmed); }
      else { debugLog(`[PiProvider] Fallback model '${trimmed}' not in registry — skipped.`); }
    }
    this.fallbackModelIds = valid;
    debugLog(`[PiProvider] Fallback chain (${valid.length}): ${valid.join(' → ') || '(none)'}`);
  }

   * (probe → runtime registry → static registry → default). Pass undefined to
   * clear (fail-open chain re-resolves per request).
   */
  setDetectedContextWindow(nCtx?: number): void {
    this.detectedContextWindow =
      typeof nCtx === 'number' && Number.isFinite(nCtx) && nCtx > 0 ? Math.floor(nCtx) : undefined;
  }

  /**
   * SDK `streamFn` wrapper — SA4E-355 UAT bug 2: the Agent loop calls this for
   * EVERY intra-turn LLM request with the full transcript, so this is the one
   * point where each request is measured against the context budget, compacted
   * when over (trim-oldest-first at tool-unit granularity) or REJECTED with
   * PI_CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (BR-09) — the provider never sees an oversized
   * request. The gate never mutates the Agent's transcript; the delegated
   * context is a new object when compaction changed the messages.
   */
  protected streamWithBudgetGate(...args: Parameters<StreamFn>): ReturnType<StreamFn> {
    const [model, context, options] = args;
    // CHAT-LOOP-CONT: fetch gateway model's maxTokens for output reserve.
    const modelMeta = this.models?.getModel?.(model.provider ?? '', model.id) as { maxTokens?: number } | undefined;
    const gated = governIntraTurnRequest({
      messages: context.messages,
      modelId: this.activeModelId ?? this.modelId ?? '',
      nCtxDetected: this.detectedContextWindow ?? this.getModelContextWindow(),
      // CHAT-LOOP-CONT: pass gateway model's maxTokens (replaces hardcoded 16384).
      reserveOutput: modelMeta?.maxTokens,
    });
    return this.models!.streamSimple(model, { ...context, messages: gated.messages }, options);
  }
```

```
/**
 * ChatPanelProvider — PiWorkflowAdapter construction (lazy engine factory).
 * Extracted from ChatPanelProvider.getEngine; the adapter configuration,
 * event fan-out behavior and comments are preserved exactly.

import * as vscode from "vscode";
import { PiWorkflowAdapter, KbRemoteCheckpointerStore } from "../../pi-workflow";
import { createLlmProvider } from "../../mcp/providers";
import { ChatExtToWebviewMessage } from "../message-protocol";
import type { IServerManager } from "../../types/server-types";

export function createChatEngine(
  mcpManager: IServerManager,
  workspaceRoot: string,
  secrets: vscode.SecretStorage | undefined,
  sendToWebview: (msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void,
  /**
   * Fan-out subscribers for engine messages (streaming-identity fix).
   * The sidebar consumes via sendToWebview; the Agentic Chat panel
   * subscribes here so engine responses actually reach it (previously
   * handleEngineEvent had zero callers — send-only dead panel).
   */
  engineListeners: Set<(msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => void>,
): PiWorkflowAdapter {
  return new PiWorkflowAdapter({
    mcpManager,
    workspaceRoot,
    onEvent: (msg: ChatExtToWebviewMessage) => {
      sendToWebview(msg);
      for (const listener of engineListeners) {
        try {
          listener(msg);
        } catch {
          // One bad subscriber must not break the sidebar.
        }
      }
    },
    llmProvider: secrets ? createLlmProvider(secrets) : undefined,
    checkpointerStore: new KbRemoteCheckpointerStore({
      workspaceRoot,
    }),
    secrets,
  });
}
```

```
async function detectInitialContextWindow(deps: ContextUsageDeps): Promise<void> {
  const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const detectedWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  if (detectedWindow && detectedWindow > 0) {
    deps.getTracker().setMaxTokens(detectedWindow);
  } else {

    if (freshWindow && freshWindow > 0) {

    }

  }
}

 * Plus base system prompt + agent instructions overhead
 */
function countInitialSteeringTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string): void {
  if (!deps.getFlags().steeringCounted) {
    // injectSteering caps at 4000 chars of steering content + system prompt base (~3500 chars)
    const SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE_CHARS = 3500;
    const MAX_STEERING_CHARS = 4000; // mirrors steering-loader.ts injectSteering budget
    const steeringChars = SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE_CHARS + MAX_STEERING_CHARS;
    deps.getTracker().updateSteeringTokens(tabId, ["x".repeat(steeringChars)]);
    deps.getFlags().steeringCounted = true;
  }
}

async function countMcpToolTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
    const tools = await engine.listAvailableTools();
    if (tools.length > 0) {
      // Build tool text matching what LLM actually receives (name + description + schema)
      const toolText = tools.map((t: any) =>
        `${t.name}: ${t.description || ""} ${JSON.stringify(t.inputSchema || {})}`
      ).join("\n");
      deps.getTracker().addToolTokens(tabId, toolText);
      debugLog(`[ChatPanel] MCP tools counted: ${tools.length} tools, ~${Math.ceil(toolText.length / 4)} tokens`);
```

```
/**
 * ContextUsageTracker — KSA-249
 * Tracks token consumption per category per tab.
 * Categories: conversation, mcpTools, steering.
 * Provides payload for webview context usage panel.
 */

import { ContextThreshold } from "./conversation-types";

export interface ContextUsagePayload {
  tabId: string;
  conversation: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  mcpTools: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  steering: { tokens: number; percentage: number };
  total: { tokens: number; percentage: number; threshold: ContextThreshold };
  maxTokens: number;
}

interface TabContextUsage {
  conversation: number;
  mcpTools: number;
  steering: number;
}

/** Thresholds for context usage state */
const THRESHOLDS = {
  safe: 0.6,
  warning: 0.8,
  critical: 0.95,
};

export class ContextUsageTracker {
  private tabUsage: Map<string, TabContextUsage> = new Map();
  private maxTokens: number;

  constructor(maxTokens = 128000) {
    this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
  }

  /**
   * Update conversation token count from messages.
   */
  updateFromMessages(tabId: string, messages: Array<{ content: string }>): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    let total = 0;
    for (const msg of messages) {
      total += this.estimateTokens(msg.content);
    }
    usage.conversation = total;
  }

  /**
   * Add tokens from tool results.
   */
  addToolTokens(tabId: string, toolResult: string): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    usage.mcpTools += this.estimateTokens(toolResult);
  }

  /**
   * Update steering token count from loaded steering content.
   */
  updateSteeringTokens(tabId: string, steeringContent: string[]): void {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    let total = 0;
    for (const content of steeringContent) {
      total += this.estimateTokens(content);
    }
    usage.steering = total;
  }

  /**
   * Set max tokens (e.g., when model changes).
   */
  setMaxTokens(maxTokens: number): void {
    this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
  }

  /**
   * Get the current usage payload for a tab.
   */
  getUsagePayload(tabId: string): ContextUsagePayload {
    const usage = this.getOrCreateUsage(tabId);
    const total = usage.conversation + usage.mcpTools + usage.steering;
    const percentage = this.maxTokens > 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round((total / this.maxTokens) * 100))
      : 0;

    return {
      tabId,
      conversation: {
        tokens: usage.conversation,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.conversation),
      },
      mcpTools: {
        tokens: usage.mcpTools,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.mcpTools),
      },
      steering: {
        tokens: usage.steering,
        percentage: this.pct(usage.steering),
      },
      total: {
        tokens: total,
        percentage,
        threshold: this.getThreshold(percentage),
      },
      maxTokens: this.maxTokens,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clear usage data for a tab.
   */
  clearTab(tabId: string): void {
    this.tabUsage.delete(tabId);
  }

  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {
    if (!text) return 0;
    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
  }

  private pct(tokens: number): number {
    return this.maxTokens > 0 ? Math.round((tokens / this.maxTokens) * 100) : 0;
  }

  private getThreshold(percentage: number): ContextThreshold {
    const ratio = percentage / 100;
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.critical) return "full";
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.warning) return "critical";
    if (ratio >= THRESHOLDS.safe) return "warning";
    return "safe";
  }

  private getOrCreateUsage(tabId: string): TabContextUsage {
    let usage = this.tabUsage.get(tabId);
    if (!usage) {
      usage = { conversation: 0, mcpTools: 0, steering: 0 };
      this.tabUsage.set(tabId, usage);
    }
    return usage;
  }
}
```

````
```ts
/**
 * SA4E-369 UAT fix (context-window bug): resolve the maxTokens denominator from
 * the RESOLVED model's real context window (getModelContextWindow — the runtime
 * registry value) FIRST. The probe value (getDetectedContextWindow) is unreliable
 * (undefined until a probe runs, and stays 0 while the gateway is offline), which
 * previously forced the tracker to fall back to a hardcoded 128000 default and
 * made every budget gate % wrong for a smaller model (e.g. 65536).
 *
 * Resolution chain:
 *   1) getModelContextWindow()  — resolved model's real context window (authoritative)
 *   2) getDetectedContextWindow() — probe meta.n_ctx (fallback for providers that
 *                                   don't expose a context window in their registry)
 *   3) undefined                  — provider fully unreachable; caller keeps tracker default
 */
export function resolveMaxTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps): number | undefined {
  const engine = deps.peekEngine() ?? deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const registryWindow = engine.getProvider().getModelContextWindow?.();
  if (typeof registryWindow === "number" && registryWindow > 0) {
    return Math.floor(registryWindow);
  }
  const probeWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  return typeof probeWindow === "number" && probeWindow > 0 ? Math.floor(probeWindow) : undefined;
}
```
````

````
async function detectInitialContextWindow(deps: ContextUsageDeps): Promise<void> {

```ts
/**
 * SA4E-369 UAT fix (context-window bug): resolve the maxTokens denominator from
 * the RESOLVED model's real context window FIRST (getModelContextWindow — the
 * runtime registry value). The probe value (getDetectedContextWindow, meta.n_ctx)
 * is unreliable: undefined until a probe runs, and 0 while the gateway is offline,
 * which previously forced a hardcoded 128000 fallback and made every budget-gate
 * % wrong for a smaller model (e.g. 65536).
 *
 * Resolution chain:
 *   1) getModelContextWindow() — resolved model's real context window (authoritative)
 *   2) getDetectedContextWindow() — probe meta.n_ctx (fallback for providers that
 *                                   don't expose a context window in their registry)
 *   3) undefined                — provider fully unreachable (keeps tracker default)
 */
export function resolveMaxTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps): number | undefined {
  const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const registryWindow = engine.getProvider().getModelContextWindow?.();
  if (typeof registryWindow === "number" && registryWindow > 0) {
    return Math.floor(registryWindow);
  }
  const probeWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  return typeof probeWindow === "number" && probeWindow > 0 ? Math.floor(probeWindow) : undefined;
}
````

````
For `resolveMaxTokens`:
```ts
/**
 * SA4E-369 UAT fix (context-window bug): resolve the maxTokens denominator from
 * the RESOLVED model's real context window FIRST (getModelContextWindow — the
 * runtime pi-ai registry value). The probe (getDetectedContextWindow, meta.n_ctx)
 * is unreliable — undefined until a probe runs, and 0 while the gateway is offline —
 * which previously forced a hardcoded 128000 fallback and made every budget-gate
 * % wrong for a smaller model (e.g. 65536 → 4% = 2621, not 5120).
 *
 * Resolution chain (never the hardcoded 128000 default):
 *   1) getModelContextWindow() — resolved model's real context window (authoritative)
 *   2) getDetectedContextWindow() — probe meta.n_ctx (fallback for providers that
 *                                   don't expose a context window in their registry)
 *   3) undefined                — provider fully unreachable (keeps tracker default)
 */
export function resolveMaxTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps): number | undefined {
  const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const registryWindow = engine.getModelContextWindow();
  if (typeof registryWindow === "number" && registryWindow > 0) {
    return Math.floor(registryWindow);
  }
  const probeWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  return typeof probeWindow === "number" && probeWindow > 0 ? Math.floor(probeWindow) : undefined;
}
```

Then refactor `detectInitialContextWindow`:
```ts
async function detectInitialContextWindow(deps: ContextUsageDeps): Promise<void> {
  // SA4E-369: prefer the resolved model's real context window; only trigger the
  // probe if the registry has no value. Never keeps the hardcoded 128000 default.
  const maxTokens = resolveMaxTokens(deps);
  if (maxTokens) {
    deps.getTracker().setMaxTokens(maxTokens);
  }
  // If undefined (provider registry empty + probe absent) — the tracker keeps
  // its constructor default until the first invoke syncs it; will be corrected.
}
```

And `syncDetectedWindowIfAny` → rename to `syncResolvedWindowIfAny`:

/** Sync maxTokens from the resolved model's real context window when available. */
export function syncResolvedWindowIfAny(deps: ContextUsageDeps): void {

  if (maxTokens) {
    deps.getTracker().setMaxTokens(maxTokens);
  }
}
```
````

```
export function updateContextUsageAfterTurn(deps: ContextUsageDeps): void {
  try {
    const engine = deps.peekEngine();
    if (!engine) return;
    const tabId = deps.getTabId();
    const detectedWindow = syncTurnWindow(deps, engine);

    const messages = engine.getChatHistory() || [];
    debugLog(`[ChatPanel] updateContextUsageAfterTurn: ${messages.length} messages, maxTokens=${detectedWindow || "default"}`);

    countTurnTokens(deps, engine, messages, tabId);

    // Send tab:contextUpdate with breakdown
    let payload = deps.getTracker().getUsagePayload(tabId);
    payload = compactIfThreshold(deps, tabId, messages, payload);

    debugLog(`[ChatPanel] context payload: total=${payload.total.tokens}, conv=${payload.conversation.tokens}, mcp=${payload.mcpTools.tokens}, steer=${payload.steering.tokens}`);
    sendContextUpdateMessage(deps.sendToWebview, tabId, payload);
  } catch (err) {
    debugLog(`[ChatPanel] updateContextUsageAfterTurn error (non-fatal): ${(err as Error).message}`);
  }
}
```

```
}

/** Count conversation tokens, one-shot steering estimate and tool definitions. */
function countTurnTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps, engine: PiWorkflowAdapter, messages: any[], tabId: string): void {
  // Count conversation tokens from messages
  deps.getTracker().updateFromMessages(
    tabId,
    messages.map((m: any) => ({ content: m.content || "" }))
  );

  countTurnSteeringOnce(deps, tabId);

  // SA4E-182: Count MCP tool definitions (schema sent to LLM on every request).
  // These are constant for the session — count once after engine has fetched tools.
  if (!deps.getFlags().toolDefinitionsCounted) {
    void engine.listAvailableTools().then((tools: Array<{ name: string; description?: string; inputSchema?: unknown }>) => {
      if (tools.length > 0) { applyToolDefinitionTokens(deps, tabId, tools); }
    }).catch(() => { /* non-fatal */ });
  }
}

/** Apply tool-definition token estimate (schema sent to LLM on every request). */
function applyToolDefinitionTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string, tools: Array<{ name: string; description?: string; inputSchema?: unknown }>): void {
  const toolText = tools.map((t: any) =>
    `${t.name}: ${t.description || ""} ${JSON.stringify(t.inputSchema || {})}`
  ).join("\n");
  const usage = (deps.getTracker() as any).tabUsage?.get(tabId);
  if (usage) { usage.mcpTools = Math.ceil(toolText.length / 4); }
  deps.getFlags().toolDefinitionsCounted = true;
  debugLog(`[ChatPanel] Tool definitions counted: ${tools.length} tools, ~${Math.ceil(toolText.length / 4)} tokens`);
}

/** Estimate steering tokens on first call — match injectSteering() actual budget. */
function countTurnSteeringOnce(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string): void {
  // System prompt base (~3500) + MAX_STEERING_CHARS (4000) = 7500 chars
  if (!deps.getFlags().steeringCounted) {
    deps.getTracker().updateSteeringTokens(tabId, [
      "x".repeat(7500),
    ]);
    deps.getFlags().steeringCounted = true;
```

```
/** SA4E-339: Auto-trigger compaction when context usage reaches threshold (TDD F-1 refetch). */
function compactIfThreshold(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string, messages: any[], payload: ContextUsagePayload): ContextUsagePayload {
  const usageFraction = normalizeUsageToFraction(payload.total.percentage);

  // SA4E-339: Auto-trigger compaction when context usage reaches threshold
  if (SessionMonitor.shouldCompact(usageFraction) === 'compact' && messages.length > 2) {
    debugLog(`[ChatPanel] Triggering auto-compaction: usageFraction=${usageFraction}, messages=${messages.length}`);
    applyCompactionAndRecount(deps, tabId, payload.maxTokens, usageFraction, messages);
    // Refetch payload after recount (TDD F-1)
    return deps.getTracker().getUsagePayload(tabId);
  }
  return payload;
}

function applyCompactionAndRecount(deps: ContextUsageDeps, tabId: string, maxTokens: number, usageFraction: number, messages: any[]): void {
  const session = buildCompactableSession(maxTokens, usageFraction, messages);
  const compResult = deps.getCompactor().compact(session);
  if (compResult.action === "compact" && compResult.session.messages.length > 0) {
    if (typeof (deps.peekEngine() as any).setChatHistory === "function") {
      (deps.peekEngine() as any).setChatHistory(compResult.session.messages);
    }
    deps.getTracker().updateFromMessages(
      tabId,
      compResult.session.messages.map((m: any) => ({ content: m.content || "" }))
    );
    debugLog(`[ChatPanel] Auto-compaction complete: tokensSaved=${compResult.tokensSaved}`);
  }
}

function buildCompactableSession(maxTokens: number, usageFraction: number, messages: any[]): CompactableSession {
  return {
    modelId: "default",
    contextWindow: maxTokens,
    usage: usageFraction,
    messages: messages.map((m: any) => ({
      role: m.role || "user",
      content: typeof m.content === "string" ? m.content : JSON.stringify(m.content),
      toolName: m.toolName,
    })),
  };
}
```

```
export function resolveMaxTokens(deps: ContextUsageDeps): number | undefined {
  const engine = deps.getOrCreateEngine();
  const registryWindow = engine.getModelContextWindow();
  if (typeof registryWindow === "number" && registryWindow > 0) {
    return Math.floor(registryWindow);
  }
  const probeWindow = engine.getDetectedContextWindow();
  return typeof probeWindow === "number" && probeWindow > 0 ? Math.floor(probeWindow) : undefined;
}
```
